stories.headline: At the Third Russia-Africa Summit, Moscow Talked Big. But Who Was Listening?
stories.summary: The picture of how the Ukraine war is reverberating across Africa is much clearer than it was in 2023 — and it doesn’t look reassuring for Moscow.
